headline: A phone-sized AI model just matched last year's giants
subhead: Nova Labs, a fictional lab used for this example, released a 3B-parameter model that runs offline on a mid-range phone.
body: The model was trained by distilling a much larger system and fits in under 2 GB of memory. Early testers report it handles summaries, translation and simple coding tasks without an internet connection, which keeps personal data on the device.
statLabel: parameters, small enough to run offline on a phone
points: Runs fully offline on a mid-range phone
Matches last year's flagship on coding tests
quote: The most important AI of the next decade will be the one that fits in your pocket.
author: Dr. Mira Okafor
question: Would you trust an AI that never touches the cloud?
myth: Useful AI needs a giant data center.
fact: Small models now run offline on phones and handle many everyday tasks.

items.title: New AI labelling rules take effect

verdict: Small wins on privacy and price. Big still wins on hard reasoning.
paper: Small Models, Big Results: Distilling Reasoning into 3B Parameters
tldr: Distilling a large model's reasoning traces into a 3B model keeps most of its benchmark score at a fraction of the size.
ticker: Nova Labs open-sources 3B model · Runs offline on phones · Free for commercial use
